Return NOT_TRAVERSED when subjects only approach, touch, strike, look through, wait at, or remain on one side of the barrier. Return UNSPECIFIED when RAW SCENE does not establish enough spatial information to tell. Do not infer validity from whether the barrier is open, closed, locked, broken, magical, or intact.
